Package hec.script

Class HecDss

java.lang.Object
hec.hecmath.DSSFile
hec.heclib.dss.HecDss
hec.script.HecDss
public class HecDss extends hec.heclib.dss.HecDss
Simple wrapper for hec.script package HecDss objects are used to retrieve and store data sets in a DSS file, as well as several utility functions for DSS files. Data is retrieved and stored using DataContainers. DataContainers are simple classes that are database independent and are how most Hec classes exchange data.
